charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1101_0100_:
One day, [Name:PlayerNickname ] was
walking along the beach when [EN:Gen Ref="255" M="he" F="she" ] came
across Shelly.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_0200_:
Pasio is such an easy place to live... I hope
we can stay here for a while.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_0400_:
I was just telling my partner how grateful
I am.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_0401_0600_: That’s right. Just sharing my honest feelings.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_0900_:
I’ve been working for Team Aqua for a
while, and my partner has stuck by my side
without complaint.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1000_:
It could be she’s happy her habitat’s
expanding...
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1100_:
Even so, I’m thankful she’s been with me
this long.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1300_:
I’m going to continue my work with Team
Aqua by protecting places Pokémon can live.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1500_:
If we have the power to change the
environment, I will for the sake of Pokémon.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1600_:
It would be great if we could make the
world a utopia for people and Pokémon.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1700_:
But unless you have immense power like
Lear, that’s hard to do.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1800_: Even if someone had power like Lear’s...
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_1900_:
whether they’d use it for Pokémon is another
question.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_2000_:
Well, humans aren’t the only ones who have
the power to change the environment.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_2500_:
When nature’s power is too strong, it can
sometimes destroy the balance of things.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_2600_: As a result, Pokémon may lose their habitats.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_2700_:
But there is one way we can resist the
power of nature.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_2800_:
That’s by humans and Pokémon working
together.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_2900_:
As Team Aqua, we think protecting Pokémon
habitats is the best path forward.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_3000_:
But who knows—you kids may find a
different way.
charaepi_ch0224_00_izumi/2301_1201_3100_:
That’s the kind of thing only little brats like
you can do, isn’t it.
